PB42-010.name: Gavv
PB42-010.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Kamen" & "Confection" family effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 3 ([Purple Core][Yellow Core])]
[During Set]
When your "Gavv" [Contract Advents], your counter can +1.

[Flash]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Besides any Magic card, switch up to a total of two "Gavv" and "Confection" family cards from your Trash with cards in your Hand. Then, if you don't have a Mirage set, you can set this card.

PB42-009.name: Henshin!! Kamen Rider Gavv
PB42-009.effect:
[Core Charge: (Kamen & Confection) ("Gavv" & Magic)]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit, or use a target Magic, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] This Nexus' symbol is also treated as Yellow.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to Void) Send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve. Then, you can -1 your counter. When you've done so, during this turn, an opposing Spirit with one core or less on it can't attack/block.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
(Can't Stack) When your "Gavv" [Contract Advents], you can draw a card.

PB42-013.name: Henshin!! Kamen Rider Geats
PB42-013.effect:
[Core Charge: (Kamen & Imp) ("DGP" & Nexus)]
◆When you Summon/Advent/Deploy a target Spirit/Nexus, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

(Can't Stack) When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Kamen" & "Imp" family effect, you can add it to the Hand.

4 [LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, this Nexus is also treated as a "Imp" family Spirit with [LV1][LV2] 3000 BP, and can only be destroyed by Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
When your "DGP" are destroyed by opposing effects, all those targets can remain on the Field in the same condition.

PB42-015.name: Henshin!! Kamen Rider Gotchard
PB42-015.effect:
[Core Charge: (Kamen & Creator) ("Chemy" & Brave) ("Chemy" & Nexus)]
◆When you Summon/Advent/Deploy a target Spirit/Brave/Nexus, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

(Can't Stack) When this card is revealed from the deck by your effect, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Gotchard", you can pay one cost to deploy it.

[Grand Skill: 4] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Your Turn)
(Send four cores from this Nexus to the Void) By adding a Blue-only "Gotchard" from your Trash to one of your Spirits with [Advent] as a pre-advent card, activate one of the (When Advents) effects written on that card as that Spirit's effect.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) All the [During OC & During Brave] effects written on the pre-advent cards of your "Gotchard" activate as that Spirit's effect.

PB42-014.name: Henshin!! Kamen Rider Revi & Kamen Rider Vice
PB42-014.effect:
[Core Charge: (Kamen & Beast Head, "Vice") ("Vice" & Nexus)]
◆When you Summon/Advent/Deploy a target Spirit/Nexus, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

This card/Nexus gains the "Beast Head" family.

[Grand Skill: 3] [LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) By discarding a "Kamen" & "Beast Head" family card from your Hand, draw two cards.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your "Revi" and "Vice" are attacking simultaneously, when the opponent would use Magic card/[Accel]/[Change] from their Hand, unless they pay one extra cost for each Spirit you control, they can't use it.

PB42-012.name: Kamen Rider Decade Complete Form 21
PB42-012.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your Cost 7 or more "Kamen" family Spirit [advents], you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By destroying an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can summon a "Kamen" family card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

PB42-X01.name: Kamen Rider Gavv AmazingGummy Form
PB42-X01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Gavv" & C3 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve. Then, by -1 counter you have, draw a card.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
During this turn, effects of every opposing Cost 4 or less Grandwalker Nexus can't activate. Then, for every ten counters you have, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve. (Max. 2)

PB42-005.name: Kamen Rider Gavv BlizzardSorbet Form
PB42-005.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Gavv" & C7 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can return an opposing LV2/LV3 Spirit to the deckbottom. By -2 your counter, this effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Heavy Armor].

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

PB42-003.name: Kamen Rider Gavv Caking Form
PB42-003.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Gavv" & C2 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can send two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve. Also, you can -1 your counter. When you've done so, send three cores from any opposing Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can draw a card from the deckbottom.

PB42-X03.name: Kamen Rider Gavv Master Mode
PB42-X03.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Gavv" & C10 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
By -1 counter you have, during this turn, while this Spirit is attacking, neither player can use non-Purple/Yellow [Change]/ [Accel]/ Magic cards.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked, and when it isn't blocked, you can [Contract Advent] a "Gavv" from your Hand onto this Spirit, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

PB42-X02.name: Kamen Rider Gavv Over Mode
PB42-X02.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Gavv" & C10 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
For every two counters you have, you can send a core from the opposing Field to the Reserve. If you have ten counters or more, this effect is treated as colorless.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit's symbol is fixed as three symbols that are treated as Purple/Yellow.

PB42-002.name: Kamen Rider Gavv ZakuzakuChips Form
PB42-002.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Gavv", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Gavv" Nexus card, and a "Confection" family card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
By -1 your counter, send up to two cores from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

PB42-006.name: Kamen Rider Valen Chocodon Form
PB42-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Gavv" Nexus card, and a "Confection" family card, besides any "Chocodon Form", to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Purple.

PB42-007.name: Kamen Rider Valen Frappe Custom
PB42-007.effect:
When your counter reduces and is four or more, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can send one core each from two opposing Spirits to the Reserve. Then, during this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit -12000 BP, and return it to the deckbottom when it is brought to 0 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
You can draw a card from the deckbottom.

PB42-004.name: Kamen Rider Vram A La Mode Mode
PB42-004.effect:
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your "Kamen" & "Confection" family Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, during this turn, you can increase the LV cost of an opposing Spirit/Nexus by +2. Then, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Gavv", you can -1 your counter. When you've done so, you can return an opposing LV1 Spirit to the deckbottom.

PB42-001.name: Kamen Rider Vram Pudding Custom
PB42-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can draw a card. Then, including being in Soul State, if you control any "Gavv", by -2 your counters, draw a card from the deckbottom.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Yellow.

PB42-011.name: Kamen Rider Zi-O Oma Form ［2］
PB42-011.effect:
When opposing Spirits would leave the Field due to your "Kamen" family effects, you can immediately activate this set card.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
By discarding a "Kamen Rider" from your Hand, destroy an opposing Spirit, and effects of the destroyed target can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
The opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects, and while you have five counters or more, your Flash Timing occurs first.

PB42-008.name: Vrocanbuggy
PB42-008.effect:
(Can't Stack) When this card is sent to the Trash by the effect of your "Henshin!! Kamen Rider Gavv", or discarded from the Hand by your "Kamen" & "Confection" family effect, you can deploy it.

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus' symbol is also treated as Yellow.

[LV2] (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) When your counter is reduced and is five or more, you can send the [Soul Core] from your Trash to "Gavv".

PB42-CX01.name: Kamen Rider Gavv PoppinGummy Form ［2］
PB42-CX01.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Soul State] [Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (Either Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your counter is reduced, if your Hand is six or less, you can draw a card.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] Flash -
Once per turn, by discarding a "Gavv", or a "Confection" family card from your Hand, your counter +4. Then, you can -1 your counter. When you've done so, you can destroy an opposing Spirit with two cores or less on it.
